{"requirements": [
{"id": 1, "text": "The game shall be playable by two players."},
{"id": 2, "text": "The game shall have two paddles, each of which shall be a rectangular block with a size of 1 x 4 blocks."},
{"id": 3, "text": "When the ball hits a paddle, or the top or bottom of the board, the ball direction shall change."},
{"id": 4, "text": "When the ball changes its direction, the new direction shall be computed with the same angle of reflection as the angle of incidence."},
{"id": 5, "text": "At game start, the ball shall move in a straight line from the center of the screen toward the left side of the board with a speed of 5 pixels/sec."},
{"id": 6, "text": "The blocks composing the rectangular board shall have a size of 10 x 10 pixels."},
{"id": 7, "text": "The paddles shall be located on the left and right side of the board."},
{"id": 8, "text": "At game start, the paddles shall be located in the middle of the vertical sides."},
{"id": 9, "text": "The ball shall be a square with a size of 1 x 2 blocks."},
{"id": 10, "text": "The game shall end when one player scores many points."},
{"id": 11, "text": "Player 1's paddle shall be on the right side and player 2's paddle shall be on the left side. Player 1 shall control the left paddle, and player 2 shall control the right paddle."},
{"id": 12, "text": "The game shall always show the correct winning message."},
{"id": 13, "text": "After a player scores a point, the game shall reset to normal conditions, and the ball shall move to the side that is fair considering who lost the last round."},
{"id": 14, "text": "The ball's speed shall be increased by 10% of its current speed every time the ball hits the top or bottom of the board, or a paddle."},
{"id": 15, "text": "The game shall allow players to select between a 1 player mode and a 2 player mode. In the 2 player mode, both paddles shall be controlled by the players."},
{"id": 16, "text": "A dashed line shall separate the two sides of the board in the horizontal center of the board."},
{"id": 17, "text": "Numbers representing the current scores of both players shall be displayed on the left and right side of the board, placed at the top of the board vertically, and shall use the lowest number of blocks necessary to display the numbers."},
{"id": 18, "text": "The background of the board shall be black, and everything else shall be white."},
{"id": 19, "text": "Every time the ball hits the top or bottom of the board, a beep sound shall be made."},
{"id": 20, "text": "Player 1's paddle shall be controlled by pressing w and s for up and down respectively. Player 2's paddle shall be controlled by pressing the up and down arrow keys for up and down respectively."}
]}
